latestVersion.changelog:
chemical-storage-sorter-2 v0.1.0

- Initial release providing automated chemical classification and compatibility checking for lab storage safety.
- Sorts chemicals into hazard groups (acids, bases, oxidizers, flammables, toxics, general).
- Identifies incompatible pairs and generates safety warnings based on standard regulations (OSHA, NFPA).
- Suggests compliant storage arrangements and best practices.
- Integrates with related inventory, safety data sheet, and disposal skills for complete lab management.
